description: Every API call Okapi found in one of your repositories at its last scan, each with its file and line, its status and the breaking changes that hit it; the broken and at risk first. Needs a free API key (Authorization: Bearer okapi_…).

repository.description: owner/name, or its id from list_repositories.

status.description: Only the calls in this status.

workspace.description: A workspace's id from list_repositories; your personal one when left out.

name: get_repository_calls
title: Read a repository's calls
